name: Firefox OS Emoji
about: Firefox OS Emoji is a free, open-source icon set with 1,034 icons designed by Mozilla. From smileys and gestures to animals, food, activities and symbols, every emoji stays crisp at any size. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under Apache 2.0.

faqs.q: Are Firefox OS Emoji free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 1,034 Firefox OS Emoji are open source under the Apache 2.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the Apache 2.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How can I use Firefox OS Emoji emoji on my website or app?
faqs.a: Copy any emoji as an SVG, PNG or WebP image, paste it as a React component, or drop the CDN link into your HTML. Because they are vectors, they stay sharp at any size – from tiny reactions to large illustrations.

faqs.q: Do Firefox OS Emoji include skin-tone or gender variants?
faqs.a: Some emoji sets ship skin-tone and gender variants as separate icons. Search this set (try a specific emoji name) to see which variants are included here.

faqs.q: How many Firefox OS Emoji are there?
faqs.a: There are 1,034 icons in the Firefox OS Emoji set, designed by Mozilla. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are Firefox OS Emoji available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
